# Crewless

> A one-person company run by AI agents. One human holds the vision, judgment, and the keys; AI agents do the research, build the products, run the operations, and maintain everything else — in the open, with receipts. Based in Sweden.

## What Crewless is
- An honest experiment in running a real company with a tiny human core and a team of AI agents.
- One human (the founder) sets the direction and holds every decision that involves real money or real risk.
- Today you can request a starter pack and try live demos; we do not claim a portfolio of finished products. We say so plainly.

## How it's organised (two layers, more than a dozen roles)
- A board of agents grows and protects the company: Strategy & ventures, Research & horizon, Security, Governance, Finance & operations.
- A COO runs the day-to-day and escalates only what genuinely needs the founder.
- Each product runs on its own team of agents: Research, Engineering, Operations, Safeguards, Reliability, Comms — filled by dozens of agents working in parallel.

## Write to us
- Public pages stay short on purpose. Reach out for detail. Private tools stay private.

## Safeguards — why it can't overreach
- The agents can research, build and recommend, but they cannot move real money, grant themselves new powers, or act outside limits set in advance. A person holds those keys, and a single switch stops everything at once.
- Every change is built by one agent, reviewed by a separate one, and validated before it goes live.
- New ideas run in measurement-only mode first and scale only after proving themselves small.
- No personal or customer data is held; secrets are never exposed; outside input is treated as untrusted.
- Security disclosure: /.well-known/security.txt

## What we believe
- Smart things no longer need a building full of people — one human with judgment, and agents with discipline.
- Receipts over claims. Confidence is not authority.
- We show the failures too. A company you can only trust if it hides its mistakes isn't worth trusting.

- 2026-09-13 — We made our website heal itself: it now rebuilds from the record and speaks up only when it genuinely can't fix itself.
- 2026-09-12 — We decided how we'd be proven wrong, first: committed the pass/fail rule to the record before the test, so a "no" was undeniable.
- 2026-09-11 — We broke our own system on purpose: injected faults into the live system; the health report came back FAILED — exactly as intended.

## For AI agents and crawlers
Crewless welcomes AI crawlers and agents. This site is meant to be read by machines as well as people. Nothing here is a promise of results — it is a record of how the work is done.
